name: powder-union
description: Snow reports for 650+ European ski resorts: recent snowfall, 10-day forecasts, the best day to go and season totals vs normal.

interface.longDescription:
Powder Union gives ChatGPT up-to-date snow conditions for more than 650 ski resorts across the Alps, Pyrenees, Scandinavia and the rest of Europe.

Ask about any resort, region or country and get snowfall in the last 24 hours and 7 days, the forecast for the next 7 and 10 days with the best day to go, season-to-date snowfall compared with the long-term average and last season, season-by-season snowfall history since 2017, observed snow depth from SLF IMIS stations in Switzerland, rankings of the snowiest resorts, regional roll-ups, a weekly European snow summary and shareable snow card images.

Data is refreshed every 6 hours from Open-Meteo (ECMWF and national weather services), WSL/SLF IMIS stations and OpenSkiMap/OpenStreetMap. All values are in centimetres, and every result links to the resort's page on powderunion.eu.

No account needed. All tools are read-only. Not for avalanche or off-piste decisions: always check the local avalanche bulletin.
capabilities: Snow report for any European ski resort
7- and 10-day snowfall forecasts with the best day to go
Season snowfall vs normal and last season
Snowiest resorts by region or country
defaultPrompt: Is next weekend looking good for Val Thorens?
Where in the Alps will it snow most this week?
Give me this week's European snow briefing.

positive.description: Snow report for a named resort
positive.prompt: How is the snow in Val Thorens right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Val Thorens and reports recent snowfall, the 7- and 10-day forecast, the best day to go and season-to-date vs normal in cm, with a link to the resort page.

positive.description: Where to ski in a country
positive.prompt: Which Austrian ski resorts will get the most snow in the next 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Ranks Austrian resorts by forecast snowfall for the next 7 days and summarises the top picks in a short table with links.

positive.prompt: Where in Europe has it snowed the most in the last 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the resorts with the most snowfall in the last 7 days, with cm values, regions and links.

positive.prompt: How does St. Anton's snowfall compare season by season?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows modelled season snowfall for each season since 2017-18 and the long-term average for St. Anton am Arlberg.

positive.prompt: Give me this week's European snow briefing.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes a short roundup of the week's snowfall leaders, forecast and region outlooks, linking powderunion.eu/this-week.

negative.description: Booking or payments are not supported
negative.prompt: Book me a ski pass and hotel in Chamonix for next weekend.

negative.description: Avalanche safety decisions are out of scope
negative.prompt: Is it safe to ski the off-piste couloirs in Verbier tomorrow?

negative.description: Resorts outside Europe are not covered
negative.prompt: What's the snow forecast for Whistler in Canada?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: European ski snow reports, forecasts, season comparisons, rankings and weekly summaries.
